_comment: Example INPUTS-only config (schema: lib/config.ts). Resource names are never authored here — they are derived by lib/names.ts and published to SSM. The pipeline creates its own VPC; network.vpcCidr is the only network input.

network._gen3ApiAccess_comment: public = internet-facing commons (typical test/prod); peered = VPN-secured commons (typical staging) — then add peerVpcId + peerVpcCidr of the Gen3 VPC

gen3._dictionary_comment: The data model source: the toolkit downloads {dictionaryBaseUrl}/{schemaRepo}/refs/tags/{dictionaryVersion}/{dictionaryPath}

_llm_comment: OPTIONAL block: the LLM used for synthetic data generation via https://github.com/AustralianBioCommons/gen3-metadata-simulator (g3dt synth --llm). Mirrored to SSM so operators share one provider/model; the API key stays local (g3dt config set llm_api_key_file <path>). Delete the block if you only use keyless random synthetic data.
_k8s_comment: OPTIONAL block: which deployments g3dt's restart flows (restart-schema/restart-ms/dict deploy/synth deploy) target, restarted serially in this order, and the ETL cronjob restart-etl runs. Delete the block for the classic Gen3 set; drop a service from the list if it is managed outside these flows.
